title: Transpose of pullback from a constant sheaf
statement: Let $g:X^\prime\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $M$ an abelian group, $F$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $a:\underline M_X\to F$. Let $L=g^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and $\alpha:\underline M_{X^\prime}\to L\underline M_X$ be the inverse constant-sheaf comparison. Let $\eta_F:\Gamma(X,F)\to\Gamma(X^\prime,LF)$ be the inverse-image unit followed by the canonical identification of sections of the pushforward [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then the transpose of $\alpha;L(a)$ under the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction on $X^\prime$ is the transpose of $a$ under that adjunction on $X$, followed by $\eta_F$.

proof.text: Use uniqueness of the two left adjoints to terminal sections to transpose the inverse constant-sheaf comparison. Expand the composite adjunction hom equivalence. Naturality of the inverse-image adjunction unit sends L(a) to a followed by the unit on F. Transport global sections to terminal sections by right-adjoint uniqueness, cancel its inverse followed by its hom, and use hom-equivalence naturality to recover the stated unit section map. These are precisely the definitions of upperStarConstantSheafIso and lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso.
